feed.title: Open Tools and Research — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1297 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Bid Price Engine — Job Bid Calculator for 120+ Trades, Margin Not Markup
entry.summary: Free job bid calculator for contractors and service trades: labor with payroll burden, materials with waste, subs, contingency and overhead turned into a price at the profit margin you choose. Shows your walk-away price and how far labor can overrun. Private, no signup.

entry.title: Canada Crypto ACB Calculator — adjusted cost base and the superficial loss rule, in your browser
entry.summary: Free Canadian crypto capital gains calculator. Paste your buys, sales, swaps and staking income as a CSV and it works out the average adjusted cost base (ACB) of each coin, applies the CRA superficial loss rule to losses, and shows each year's taxable capital gain. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Discogs Fee Calculator — What You Keep After the 9% Fee and Processing
entry.summary: Free Discogs seller fee calculator: the 9% selling fee on item price plus shipping ($0.10 minimum, $150 maximum), editable payment processing, your payout and profit after postage and cost, the price that hits a target profit, and a fee ladder from $3 singles to $2,500 grails. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Hands-Free Language Coach — voice-only language practice while you drive or walk
entry.summary: Learn a language by voice alone: the coach says a phrase, you say it back, it listens and scores you, and moves on. No tapping, no screen. Streaks, XP and spaced review like a language game, free in your browser, plus a skill for Claude and ChatGPT voice mode.

entry.title: Listen & Learn Audio — bilingual audio stories for language learners, hands-free
entry.summary: Short graded stories read aloud in Spanish, French, German and Italian, each line followed by English. Press play and listen while you walk or commute. Free in your browser, plus an AI skill for Claude and ChatGPT voice mode that tells new stories and podcast-style episodes on any topic, at your level.

entry.title: Open Tennis Robots — open-source tennis ball machine with a catch net, and a ball pickup robot
entry.summary: Build your own tennis ball machine that catches your returns with a moving net, and a robot that picks up tennis balls while you practise. Open-source hardware designs, firmware and software (MIT), plus a shot simulator you can try in your browser.

entry.title: US Substantial Presence Test Calculator — 183-Day Weighted Count
entry.summary: Free calculator for the IRS substantial presence test: enter your days in the US and see the 183-day weighted count (this year + a third of last year + a sixth of the year before), how many more days you can spend before you become a US tax resident, and when you crossed the line. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Demand Forecast Back-Tester — safety stock and reorder points from your sales
entry.summary: Free demand forecasting for small sellers. Upload a sales CSV to get a back-tested forecast per SKU, safety stock and reorder points at your service level, ABC-XYZ classes, and an honest check of whether the forecast beats repeating last month. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Grailed Fee Calculator — What You Keep After the New 6% / 9% Commission
entry.summary: Free Grailed seller fee calculator for the tiered commission (6% under $120 with a $1.99 minimum, 9% from $120) plus 3.49% + $0.49 payment processing. See your payout, profit, the price for a target profit, and the $120 step where the whole sale jumps to 9%. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Meeting Notes to Action Items Extractor (Free)
entry.summary: Paste meeting notes or a transcript and get action items with owner and due date, decisions and open questions, plus a follow-up email. Free, private, no upload.

entry.title: Free On-Page SEO Audit and AI-Readiness Checker — Page SEO Audit
entry.summary: Paste a page's HTML for a scored SEO and AI-readiness audit: title, description, headings, canonical, JSON-LD, alt text, each with its fix. Free, private.

entry.title: Free Price Drop and Back-in-Stock Alerts (Self-Hosted)
entry.summary: Get price drop and back-in-stock alerts for any product page, free. Runs on your own GitHub Actions, alerts your phone, no account or tracking. Test a page in your browser first.

entry.title: TCGplayer Fee Calculator — What You Keep After 10.75% Commission and the $0.30 Order Fee
entry.summary: Free TCGplayer seller fee calculator: 10.75% marketplace commission (capped at $75 per product, charged on cards plus shipping) and 2.5% + $0.30 per-order transaction fee. See your payout, profit per order, the price for a target profit, and Pro or pre-February-2026 rates side by side. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: UK Crypto CGT Calculator — Section 104 pool, same-day and 30-day rules, in your browser
entry.summary: Free UK crypto capital gains calculator. Paste your buys, sales, swaps and staking income as a CSV and it applies HMRC's same-day, 30-day and Section 104 pooling rules, works out each tax year's gain, exempt amount and estimated CGT, and exports the working. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: UK Statutory Residence Test Checker — Days, Ties and Automatic Tests
entry.summary: Free UK Statutory Residence Test checker: enter your UK stays and ties to see which test decides, whether you are UK resident, and how many more days you can spend in the UK before that changes. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Youth Lineup Rotator — fair playing time for every kid, free
entry.summary: Free youth sports lineup generator for volunteer coaches. Equal playing time, nobody benched twice in a row, goalkeeper turns shared, subs planned per period. Soccer, basketball, hockey and more. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Schedule Cron Check — Invalid, Too-Frequent and Top-of-Hour Crons
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every schedule cron that is invalid, faster than GitHub's 5-minute minimum, or pinned to the top of the hour where scheduled runs get delayed. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Financial Aid Award Letter Comparator — true cost of each college offer
entry.summary: Free financial aid award letter comparator. Type in each college's cost, grants, loans and work-study and see the true four-year cost, loans repaid with interest, the year-2 price jump and the grant that would match the cheapest offer. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: JWT Security Check — decode a token and find misconfigurations
entry.summary: Paste a JWT and get its header and payload decoded, plus every common security misconfiguration flagged: alg:none, embedded jwk/jku/x5u/x5c key material, symmetric-vs-asymmetric algorithm confusion, a kid header shaped like path traversal or SQL injection, missing/excessive exp, and sensitive-looking fields in the unencrypted payload. Free JWT decoder and security checker, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Review Reply Desk — free Google review reply generator for local businesses
entry.summary: Free review response generator. Paste your Google, Yelp or Facebook reviews and get a ready-to-post reply to each one: rating-aware, specific, safe around legal, health-privacy and refund traps, and checked before you post. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
